policy_name: cart items belong to user cart
using_expression:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM carts c
  WHERE ((c.id = cart_items.cart_id) AND (c.user_id = auth.uid()))))
with_check_expression:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM carts c
  WHERE ((c.id = cart_items.cart_id) AND (c.user_id = auth.uid()))))
policy_definition_text:
CREATE POLICY "cart items belong to user cart" ON public.cart_items FOR * TO PUBLIC USING ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM carts c
  WHERE ((c.id = cart_items.cart_id) AND (c.user_id = auth.uid()))))) WITH CHECK ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM carts c
  WHERE ((c.id = cart_items.cart_id) AND (c.user_id = auth.uid())))))
